input.description: The caller's entry exactly as provided (objects are JSON-stringified).

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable outcome code, e.g. OK, INVALID_DATE, AMBIGUOUS_ADAR.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation, set when status is "error".

direction.description: Which way this entry was converted.

gregorian.description: The Gregorian calendar date shown (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

weekday.description: English weekday name of the Gregorian date.

afterSunset.description: Whether the Hebrew day shown began the evening before the Gregorian date.

hebrewDayGregorian.description: The Gregorian civil date that the Hebrew calendar day falls on (ISO), accounting for afterSunset.

beginsAtSunsetOn.description: The Gregorian evening (ISO date) when this Hebrew day begins.

hebrewMonthHe.description: Hebrew month name in Hebrew letters.

hebrewMonthNumber.description: Month number, Nisan = 1 ... Tishrei = 7 ... Adar = 12, Adar II = 13.

hebrewString.description: Formatted English Hebrew date, e.g. "17 Tishrei 5787".

hebrewStringHe.description: Formatted Hebrew date in gematria, e.g. "י״ז בתשרי תשפ״ז".

isLeapYear.description: Whether the Hebrew year has 13 months (Adar I + Adar II).

holiday.description: Jewish holiday(s) on this day, in English, if any.

holidayHe.description: Jewish holiday(s) on this day, in Hebrew, if any.

parasha.description: Weekly Torah portion, in English, when this day is Shabbat and has one.

anniversaries.description: In anniversary mode: the next occurrences (Hebrew and Gregorian dates) with the rule that applied.

ruleNote.description: In anniversary mode: an explanation when a leap-year / 30-Cheshvan / 30-Kislev rule affected the results.
